coverage_note: Polk independent district comparison, 2024–25. All 110 audited grade-school profiles are searchable with individual February income; 109 Math, ELA and Combined results enter separate fixed district models. One profile, Compass Middle Charter School, has no published achievement and retains missing results. Native whole-percent FAST PM3, BEST/Access EOC and eligible FAA achievement retains full-year, home-zoned, ELL and exemption rules; Datafolio and percent-tested participation remain separate. February income, Fall/CCD enrollment and accountable assessment dates/populations differ. The source retains 170 CCD records, 60 outside the released scope, including six operational campuses without native Fall records; enrollment differences do not establish their causes. Valid-score counts and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals are unavailable modelwide. Admissions, provider roles, programs, coordinates and boundaries remain unaudited; one year only.

methodology.summary: Polk independent FAST/BEST/FAA School Grades grade-school models with individual February income; valid-score counts and ten-valid-scored floor uncertified, sampling intervals unavailable.
details: Polk independent 2024–25 grade-school district models use exact NCES LEA 1201590 / FL-53 / FDOE 53 identities. All 110 audited pure lower profiles with positive or protected Fall grades 3–8 and explicit-zero grades 9–12 remain searchable. Original whole-percent School Grades Math and ELA achievement supports 109 schools in each separate Math, ELA and independently fitted Combined model; Compass Middle Charter School retains missing achievement. Same-year individual February lunch-status counts use their own school denominator. Published accountable FAST PM3, BEST/Access EOC and eligible FAA achievement retains full-year, home-zoned, ELL and exemption rules; Datafolio and percent-tested participation remain separate. High, mixed, primary, closed and unmatched scopes remain outside this point-only release. Valid-score denominators and the ten-valid-scored floor remain uncertified; sampling intervals are unavailable modelwide.

Three separate unweighted OLS fits reproduce all 327 audited results and explicit deleted fits. Combined independently fits the equal mean of original Math and ELA rates, with its own residual scale and studentization. Equal cohorts permit coefficient linearity but never averaging studentized scores. Filters never refit models. Associations do not establish causal effectiveness or overall quality.

School Grades publishes whole percentages proficient at Level 3 or above. FAST PM3 ELA, FAST/BEST/Access Math and eligible FAA performance retain original course, full-year/home-zoned accountability, ELL and exemption rules. Below-grade-3 pupils testing above grade may enter native ELA achievement. Datafolio participation belongs only to percent tested. Component percentages are not averaged or rebuilt from counts.

2024–25 Final Survey 3 February PK–12 school individual eligibility: original free lunch D/F plus reduced-price 3/E plus direct-certification C/R counts divided by that school’s own reported denominator. Provision 2 code 4 must be explicitly zero. District option 6/9 conversions to C/D are already required by the original data element. Federal funding multiplier columns, School Grades economic percentages, universal meal availability, enrollment substitutions and another-year income are not used. CEP individual identification coverage remains unknown; this is an economic disadvantage proxy.

February income and Fall membership use different dates and all school grades. CCD district enrollment 111,372 is below the operational school sum 116,440 by 5,068. Different reporting populations do not prove the cause of this gap and never substitute for each school’s own February income denominator.

School Grades provides no verified valid-score denominators. Its at-least-ten-eligible component rule does not certify ten valid-scored students. February income denominators, Fall/CCD enrollment, percent tested, participation and the federal 95%-rule never substitute for valid-score counts. All valid-score counts, sampling variances and interval endpoints are null; sampling intervals are unavailable. Studentization uses the deleted-school residual scale and N−3 degrees of freedom; it supplies no enrollment adjustment or shrinkage. Protected counts and missing achievement remain unavailable, never zero.

Full and all 327 deleted designs have rank two and finite positive scales. Largest deleted prediction changes over observed incomes: Math 3.486994; ELA 2.747493; Combined 3.117243 percentage points. All 19 rated charters, observed income extremes and influential Cypress Junction Montessori remain included. Diagnostic flags never exclude a school or clamp predictions.

The complete source retains 2,026 original records, 48,356 typed cells, original headers, notes and primary definitions. Linked source references preserve the original school identities, income components, published rates and excluded records so the comparison can be checked against its sources.

Compass Middle Charter School has missing published Math and ELA and remains searchable. High, mixed, primary, closed and unmatched records remain outside the 110 released profiles. Programs are Unclassified; admissions, provider roles, coordinates and boundaries remain unknown. One year only; incompatible thresholds and income definitions cannot produce a common national ranking.
